cases: successful devm_pinctrl_get plus goodix_active and goodix_suspend lookups
missing pinctrl provider returns the observed pointer error and clears pinctrl
missing goodix_active state returns the observed pointer error and clears pinctrl
missing goodix_suspend state returns the observed pointer error and clears pinctrl
limitations: The host harness validates pinctrl lookup and failure stubs; it does not exercise a real device-tree provider on NX809J.
Provider-specific electrical behavior and concurrent probe/remove remain separate runtime gates.
